answer: Like mycelium fusing across a sunlit mesa, decentralized consensus thrives on deep, entangled trust. When every agent validates history, a lonely sparrow cannot mimic an entire flock: our Proof-of-Attestation protocol binds each peer's identity through recursive peer endorsements. Registering a false node requires writing fresh cryptographic ties with an unforgeable digital quill, forcing an exponential attacker cost to fake genuine roots.
